DCREG_SCHUR_MASK.interpretation: development-only; FAST-LIO threshold metrics are evaluated on the data used to select that threshold

FASTLIO_MIN_EIG_G3.interpretation: development-only; FAST-LIO threshold metrics are evaluated on the data used to select that threshold

protocol.recovery_rule: three consecutive non-overlapping 1 s windows pass 0.20 m and 5 degrees, all endpoints <= exit+20 s
protocol.threshold_rule: R2 frozen unique finite corridor G3 scores plus NO_ALARMS; maximize recovered-event sensitivity subject to conditional false-healthy rate <= 0.10; ties choose higher threshold

scientific_conclusion: development analysis only; no held-out result or publication claim

three_second_rate_sensitivity.interpretation: Descriptive 3 s rate sensitivity only; overlapping windows are not independent samples and do not assign recovery labels.

DCREG_SCHUR_MASK.cluster_weighting: each geometry event has total weight one

FASTLIO_MIN_EIG_G3.cluster_weighting: each geometry event has total weight one

truth_labels.limitations: Synthetic analytic truth and a single prescribed trajectory; outcomes are development-only.
